text:
Maria: Quick heads-up — aiming to publish the Py/TS SDKs in the 11:00 PT quiet window. Need a last-pass on the ambassador compatibility shim + signer rotation before we flip tags. Can everyone confirm their checklist items?

alex: I can run the canary smoke at 10:45. Will validate packaging and basic imports. :eyes:

nate: Rollback criteria proposal: 
- checksum mismatch on any wheel/tarball
- >5% 5xx errors in the first 15m of canary traffic
- lint/build failure during publish steps
If any trigger hits, we yank the dist-tag and revert signer rotation.

Maria: Agree on criteria. Add: CI job failure on `publish-smoke` should auto-abort publish. Also ensure tokens rotated back if we rollback.

sarah: I'll post the changelog and copy for the release notes once publish completes, and pre-create the deprecation note for legacy sync client. Will ping #marketing for the blurb.

alex: Publishing commands (local dry run):
```bash
# build python packages
python -m build -o dist/
# verify checksums
sha256sum dist/* > dist/SHA256SUMS
# npm canary publish
yarn workspace @redwood/sdk-ts publish --tag canary
```
I'll run these in the CI canary step.

tim: If we need to revert dist-tags quick: 
```bash
# remove canary tag and reassign stable
npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk-ts canary || true
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk-ts 1.2.3 latest
# for pip, reupload signed wheel to previous release or block via package index rules
```
Also: ensure the signer key used for rotation has the previous key imported into KMS for fallback.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot started canary run at 2799990300 for py/ts SDK publish. Canary targets: 50 requests/min for 15m, smoke tests + import matrix.

alex: Canary smoke passed local import matrix (py3.9/3.10/3.11) at 2799990345. No import errors. :thumbsup:

nate: Observability hooks added: trace id prefix `publish-canary-2799990000`, alert if error rate > 5% or token cost anomaly.

Maria: Two quick asks before we go full: (1) confirm docs link pinned in release note, (2) ops oncall aware for the 11:00->11:30 window. @tim can you confirm ops ping?

tim: Ops aware. I'll be @oncall and will post to #eng-oncall 5m before full publish. If alerts fire, I'll initiate rollback steps and coordinate with @nate and @alex.

sarah: Changelog ready draft: includes deprecation note for legacy sync client (soft deprecate, 30d grace). Will attach to PR after canary.

Maria: Good. Proceeding with full publish at 11:00 PT unless any objections in next 10m. If you see anything weird during canary, call it out and we halt. :pray: 

deploy-bot: Canary completed at 2799990420 — smoke suite green. No checksum mismatches detected.

alex: Rolling to full publish now (starting 2799990500). Will monitor packaging integrity.

nate: Monitoring dashboards up. Traces tagged. If error rate spikes, I'll trigger rollback and post the incident playbook link.

deploy-bot: Full publish completed at 2799990580. Tags: `latest` -> 1.6.0, `canary` removed.

Maria: Release done. Sarah — please push release notes and the deprecation announcement. Tim/nate/alex — stand down unless alerts. Thanks all. :tada:

sarah: Posted release notes and deprecation PR at 2799990595 — https://github.com/redwood/sdk/releases/tag/v1.6.0. Included migration snippet and compat shim notes.

tim: No alerts during 11:00-11:30 window. Marking as successful. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
